title: relay_queue: Vec::new() without capacity hint before push loop
description: relay_queue.rs drain_once line 194: let mut env_files: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new(); then pushed in a loop. The directory entry count is not known in advance, but the async ReadDir stream could be collected into a Vec via a stream adapter. Minor: at least Vec::new() is fine here since capacity is unknown; this is a low-priority style note only if a collect-based approach is readable.
